Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1028
Claimant:
Katie Nguyen
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
2024-03-05
First notice of loss received from the insured driver reporting a low-speed head-on collision in a parking area; the
driver reports neck discomfort and a visit to urgent care the same day.
2024-03-13
Confirmed the driver is named on the policy and that coverage was in force at the time of loss; no coverage questions
identified at this stage.
2024-04-20
Claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact will go through the attorney's office. Requested the initial
medical records and the police report.
2024-04-24
Police report received and reviewed; it describes the same sequence of events the claimant gave at intake, and the
other driver's statement agrees on the sequence and location.
2024-05-11
Photographs from the scene and the vehicle inspection show front-end damage consistent with the impact described,
and the estiamte lines up with the reported force of the collision.
2024-05-12
Spoke with two independent witnesses who each confirmed the collision happened as described; neither had any
stake in the outcome.
2024-07-01
Reviewed the vehicle history and prior claims; no earlier damage to this vehicle or the same front-end area is on
record.
2024-08-12
Medical records show a neck strain diagnosis, with a treatment plan of physical therapy and medication that followed
a usual course; the claimant's reported improvement has been steady.
2024-08-22
The claimant's account has stayed consistent across the recorded call, the written statement, and the follow-up
interview through counsel; there is no record of earlier neck complaints. Seating position in the vehicle at impact is
still not fully clear from the statements and will be clarified with counsel.
2024-08-27
Treatment has tapered to periodic check-ins as recovery progresses; the file is being prepared for evaluation of the
bodily injury claim with the medical records and repair documentation attached.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
